surface: Appy personal agent workspace, interactive local concept
userJob: Delegate a bounded task to an owned machine and return to a useful result, resolving only decisions that need a person.
primaryAction: Enter a goal, review the suggested plan and access, then start the simulated task.
hierarchy: Review the plan and access before starting
Pending decisions first in a compact task list
Result first; access and activity available on request
direction: Neutral charcoal workspace; restrained periwinkle actions; local Inter font; one 8px rectangular radius; consistent left alignment and spacing; no promotional side rail.
constraints: No runtime external asset, font, analytics or production-action requests; bundled Inter is local.
One obvious primary action per stage
No native-desktop folder confinement or instant offline-stop claims
Home contains a composer, collapsed examples and three task rows; no device/model/sample rail
Body text 15px, primary buttons 14px, metadata 13px; form fields 15px desktop/16px phone; desktop shortcut hint 12px
Human-readable approval target, account, effect and full body stay visible; HTTP metadata may be disclosed

contentStates.loading: A simulated task step shows bounded progress and clear simulation framing.
contentStates.empty: Filtered task/search/approval views explain the empty result and provide a next action.
contentStates.error: Incompatible route or missing goal blocks starting and explains recovery.
contentStates.partial: Offline and locked devices remain visible alongside available work.
contentStates.success: Completed simulated work exposes an output and an activity receipt.
contentStates.permission: Exact-action review and native desktop access explain authority before approval.

typography.family: Inter, locally bundled with SIL OFL license
typography.controls: Primary buttons 14px / 1.5; form fields 15px desktop, 16px phone

radius: 8px for rectangular surfaces and controls; circles only for step/status markers.
